# Third-party sources

Copies of upstream crates, routed in through the `[patch]` tables of the root `Cargo.toml`
(generated by `scripts/sync_zed_workspace.py`, which owns the `VENDORED` list).

| Path | Upstream | Revision |
|---|---|---|
| `fs/` | Zed `crates/fs` (GPL-3.0-or-later) | `5adae449a366fd8f8f87d983287d95eab37e9488` |
| `settings/` | Zed `crates/settings` (GPL-3.0-or-later) | `5adae449a366fd8f8f87d983287d95eab37e9488` |
| `trash-rs/` | https://github.com/zed-industries/trash-rs (MIT) | `41c6c80` as locked by Zed at the revision above |

`settings` embeds `../../assets` relative to its crate directory, so Zed's `assets/keymaps` and
`assets/settings` are copied to the repository-root `assets/`.

Upstream's `LICENSE-GPL` symlinks (to the Zed repository root) are regular files here. `trash-rs/`
omits `.cargo-ok` and `.github/`.

The copies are currently unmodified. Any change must be listed here.
